column1: [Section: Governance, Interpretation & Policy Administration] Governance, Interpretation & Policy Administration INTERNAL - ALL EMPLOYEES Asterion Technologies Private Limited ("Asterion" or "the Company") provides software engineering, cloud modernisation, managed application services and enterprise technology consulting from its four Indian offices.

[Section: D4. Secrets and API keys] D4. Secrets and API keys Secrets must be stored in the managed vault, never in source code, chat, issue trackers or build logs. Service credentials rotate at least every 90 days; privileged credentials every 30 days. Suspected exposure requires immediate revocation, rotation and incident declaration. Production keys must be scoped to a single service and environment.

[Section: D5. Employee laptop baseline] D5. Employee laptop baseline | Security setting Disk encryption   | Minimum standard Full-disk encryption enabled; recovery key escrowed with IT. | |------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------| | Screen lock                        | Automatic lock after 5 minutes of inactivity. | | Endpoint protection                | Managed EDR active and reporting; tamper protection enabled. | | Operating system                   | Critical security updates within 7 calendar days; high-risk updates within 14 days. | | Local administrator                | Not granted by default; exception expires within 7 days unless renewed. | | Removable media                    | Blocked by default; encrypted company-issued media only with IT approval. | | Device loss                        | Report to IT Service Desk and Security within 30 minutes of discovery. |

[Section: G. Compliance & Internal Governance - Core Controls] G. Compliance & Internal Governance - Core Controls INTERNAL - ALL EMPLOYEES The Company maintains controls designed to support lawful, ethical and secure operations. This section distinguishes statutory obligations from additional internal requirements adopted by Asterion.

[Section: G2. Personal data] G2. Personal data Personal data must be collected for a defined business purpose, limited to what is necessary, kept accurate where practicable, protected by reasonable security safeguards and retained only for the approved period. Access, correction, erasure, grievance and breach-response requests must be routed to the designated privacy contact. The Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and rules/commencement notifications applicable at the relevant time must be considered by Legal and the privacy function; this handbook does not itself determine the commencement or applicability of each provision.
